value.message: MedlinePlus (warfarin): some foods and beverages that contain vitamin K can affect how warfarin works; it advises eating consistent amounts of vitamin K-containing food week to week.

values.source_doc_id: MedlinePlus Drug Information: Warfarin - special dietary instructions

value.message: MedlinePlus (phenelzine): eating foods high in tyramine during treatment can cause a serious reaction; tyramine is found in meat, poultry, fish or cheese that has been smoked, aged, improperly stored or spoiled, and some other foods.

values.source_doc_id: MedlinePlus Drug Information: Phenelzine - special dietary instructions
values.next_expected_change: page revisions are not scheduled; re-check at each refresh

value.message: MedlinePlus (simvastatin, atorvastatin): talk to your doctor about eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine.

values.source_doc_id: MedlinePlus Drug Information: Simvastatin (also Atorvastatin, a600045) - special dietary instructions
values.next_expected_change: page revisions are not scheduled; re-check at each refresh

value.message: MedlinePlus (lisinopril): talk to your doctor before using salt substitutes containing potassium; potassium supplements may interact with lisinopril.

values.source_doc_id: MedlinePlus Drug Information: Lisinopril - interactions and special dietary instructions
values.next_expected_change: page revisions are not scheduled; re-check at each refresh
values.note: Only the lisinopril page was fetched; other ACE inhibitors are matched by the class term and flagged for pharmacist confirmation (LM-G27).

value.message: NIDDK: for people with chronic kidney disease, choosing foods and avoiding those high in sodium, potassium and phosphorus may prevent or delay some health problems; a dietitian can help plan meals.

values.source_doc_id: NIDDK (NIH): Healthy Eating for Adults with Chronic Kidney Disease
